question: R2: which widening drops keep their rows until let go? No rule in the reads separates them: CAP-TEXTWIDTH4.json l wider 5 keeps where CAP-TEXTWIDTH8.json g1 wider 2, the same heights 156.8 to 134.4, falls; the short Text keeps at 1 and 6 columns and falls at 4 (CAP-TEXTWIDTH7.json f4, f7, f3). Width one step, two steps, half a column or a column before the end, step size and row slack all fail on our own text heights. This round looks for it, one thing at a time. Predictions are ours as built: the rows fall at the drop by the height lost, always. Seen: a1 (f4), a4 (f3), a6 (f7) and b1 (CAP-TEXTWIDTH4.json m1, m2; CAP-TEXTWIDTH5.json t, u, v); ours is known to miss a1, a6 and b1.
